from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional, List

class UniversityRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single university's data extracted from one CDS document."""
    university_name: str = Field(description="The name of the university")
    graduation_rate_2015: Optional[float] = Field(description="Six-year graduation rate for Fall 2015 cohort; None if not available in this document")
    admitted_count: int = Field(description="Number of admitted first-time, first-year students")
    applied_count: int = Field(description="Number of first-time, first-year applicants")
    admissions_year: str = Field(description="The year of the admission statistics, e.g., 'Fall 2021'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_records: List[UniversityRecord]
